paragraphs.zh: 一个由真实AI智能体做真实工作的活像素风工作站。

paragraphs.en: StarNet is a local-first desktop harness where you create AI agents, organize them into a pixel-art space station, and watch them perform real work with real models and tools. The station is not decoration — it is a projection of live runtime state, and the product contract is literal: A room is a capability-scoped team , a hallway is an authorized handoff lane, and a placed object is a real capability grant . The layout you draw is the workflow the agents run.
paragraphs.zh: StarNet 是一个本地优先的桌面型框架，你可以在这里创建智能体，将它们组织到一个像素画风格的空间站中，并观察它们使用真实的模型和工具完成实际工作。 这座空间站并非装饰——它是实时运行状态的投射，产品契约是字面意义上的：一个房间是一个按能力划分范围的团队，一条走廊是一条经过授权的交接通道，一个放置的物件是一项真实的能力授权。 你画出的布局就是智能体运行的工作流。

paragraphs.en: Start with one agent, then place bays or summon specialists to run more, concurrently — each a genuinely distinct, bounded agent run with its own workspace and permissions. The harness performs real model calls, real tools, real cost rather than animating a simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 从一个智能体开始，然后放置隔间或召唤专家来运行更多智能体，并发执行——每一个都是真正独立、有边界的智能体运行，拥有各自的工作区和权限。 该框架执行真实的模型调用、真实的工具、真实的成本，而不是播放一场模拟。

paragraphs.en: StarNet does not simulate revenue, completed work, model activity, or spend. Its core product law is that the interface must never assert state the harness cannot prove.

paragraphs.en: The public release train supports Windows and macOS. It refuses to stage a release unless the Windows installer passes Authenticode and timestamp verification, both Mac builds pass Developer ID checks and Apple notarization, and every updater artifact has a valid updater signature. Those are pipeline requirements, not proof that a particular downloaded or installed copy was tested on your machine; INSTALL.md explains what to verify and when to stop. Linux packages are internal build artifacts only and are not a supported public release target.
paragraphs.zh: 公开发布列车支持 Windows 和 macOS。 除非 Windows 安装程序通过 Authenticode 和时间戳验证、两个 Mac 构建都通过 Developer ID 检查和 Apple 公证，并且每个更新程序工件都拥有有效的更新程序签名，否则它会拒绝执行发布暂存。 这些是流水线要求，并不能证明某个特定下载或安装的副本已在你的机器上经过测试；INSTALL.md 说明了需要验证什么以及何时停止。 Linux 软件包仅是内部构建工件，并不是受支持的公开发布目标。

paragraphs.en: The sidecar uses Node core modules only, so it runs without installing anything:
paragraphs.zh: 该 sidecar 仅使用 Node 核心模块，因此无需安装任何内容即可运行：

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/androoAGI/starnet.git cd starnet node sidecar/index.js Open http://localhost:8787 , then connect a provider — bring your own OpenRouter API key (BYOK) or use a supported OAuth sign-in. Provider requests leave your machine when you run an agent; station state, transcripts, memory, and ledgers stay in the local StarNet workspace unless you explicitly use a network tool or connector. See PRIVACY.md for the full data map.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/androoAGI/starnet.git cd starnet node sidecar/index.js 打开 http://localhost:8787 ，然后连接一个提供商——自带 OpenRouter API 密钥（BYOK）或使用受支持的 OAuth 登录。 当你运行智能体时，提供商请求会离开你的机器；站点状态、转录记录、记忆和账本都保留在本地 StarNet 工作区中，除非你显式使用网络工具或连接器。 完整的数据映射请参见 PRIVACY.md。

paragraphs.en: No key, no account, no bill: install Ollama , pull a model ( ollama pull qwen3:8b ), and pick OLLAMA as the provider — on the first-run brain screen, or later in SETTINGS → PROVIDERS . StarNet talks to Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 and only reports it ready once it can list your local models. Pick a model that supports tools ( ollama show <model> lists them): agents act through tool calls. Honest caveat: local models are smaller than the cloud ones, so expect slower and rougher work on long tasks, and a task needs a large context window — an 8B model takes about 10 GB of graphics memory while it works.
paragraphs.zh: 无需密钥、无需账户、无需账单：安装 Ollama，拉取一个模型（ollama pull qwen3:8b），然后选择 OLLAMA 作为提供商——可以在首次运行的智能体配置界面选择，也可以稍后在「设置」→「提供商」中选择。 StarNet 通过 127.0.0.1:11434 与 Ollama 通信，只有能够列出你的本地模型时才会显示为就绪。 选择一个支持工具的模型（ollama show <model> 会列出这些工具）：智能体通过工具调用来执行操作。 坦诚的提醒：本地模型比云端模型更小，因此在长任务中预计会更慢、效果更粗糙，而且任务需要较大的上下文窗口——一个 8B 模型在运行时大约占用 10 GB 显存。

paragraphs.en: npm ci npm run desktop:dev # dev shell npm run desktop:build # build installers locally Terminal mode The desktop app ships a starnet command beside it. Run it with no arguments and it opens a live dashboard on the station the app is running: the crew down the left (a spinner on whoever is working), the chosen agent's conversation beside it, and every approval as a card you answer with y or n ( v shows the full request first). It reads the same state the app does, so it never shows work the station cannot prove.
paragraphs.zh: npm ci npm run desktop:dev # 开发环境外壳 npm run desktop:build # 本地构建安装包 终端模式 桌面应用会附带一个 starnet 命令。 不带参数运行它，它会在运行该应用的工作站上打开一个实时仪表盘：左侧是全体船员（正在工作的人显示一个旋转加载图标），旁边是所选智能体的对话，每个审批请求都以卡片形式呈现，你可以用 y 或 n 来回应（按 v 会先显示完整请求）。 它读取的是与应用相同的状态，因此它绝不会显示工作站无法证实的工作内容。

sents.en: npm ci npm run desktop:dev # dev shell npm run desktop:build # build installers locally Terminal mode The desktop app ships a starnet command beside it.
sents.zh: npm ci npm run desktop:dev # 开发环境外壳 npm run desktop:build # 本地构建安装包 终端模式 桌面应用会附带一个 starnet 命令。

sents.en: Run it with no arguments and it opens a live dashboard on the station the app is running: the crew down the left (a spinner on whoever is working), the chosen agent's conversation beside it, and every approval as a card you answer with y or n ( v shows the full request first).

sents.en: It reads the same state the app does, so it never shows work the station cannot prove.
sents.zh: 它读取的是与应用相同的状态，因此它绝不会显示工作站无法证实的工作内容。

paragraphs.en: So you can just type starnet in a new terminal: the Windows installer puts that folder on your user PATH (the uninstaller takes it off), and on macOS StarNet links the command into ~/.local/bin the first time it starts, adding that folder to ~/.zprofile if no shell profile has it yet ( STARNET_NO_CLI_LINK=1 turns that off). Other commands: starnet ls (every agent and its open asks), starnet approve / starnet deny , starnet watch (the live event stream, one line each), starnet flow (workflows) and starnet -p "<task>" (one run, answer on stdout). starnet --help lists them all. From a checkout, use node bin/starnet.js .
paragraphs.zh: 所以你只需在新终端里输入 starnet：Windows 安装程序会把该文件夹加入你的用户 PATH（卸载程序会将其移除），而在 macOS 上，StarNet 会在首次启动时把该命令链接到 ~/.local/bin，并在没有任何 shell 配置文件包含该路径时把它添加到 ~/.zprofile（设置 STARNET_NO_CLI_LINK=1 可关闭此功能）。 其他命令：starnet ls（列出每个智能体及其待批准的请求）、starnet approve / starnet deny、starnet watch（实时事件流，每个事件一行）、starnet flow（工作流）以及 starnet -p "<task>"（单次运行，答案输出到 stdout）。starnet --help 会列出所有命令。 若使用代码检出目录，请用 node bin/starnet.js。

paragraphs.en: StarNet can import an existing agent: point it at your on-disk OpenClaw or Hermes home and it mints a StarNet agent from the persona, instructions, memory, and model it finds. API keys never transfer — you re-enter those in the KEYS tab.
paragraphs.zh: StarNet 可以导入现有的智能体：将它指向你磁盘上的 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 主目录，它会根据找到的人设、指令、记忆和模型铸造一个 StarNet 智能体。 API 密钥不会被迁移——你需要在 KEYS 标签页中重新输入它们。

sents.en: API keys never transfer — you re-enter those in the KEYS tab.
sents.zh: API 密钥不会被迁移——你需要在 KEYS 标签页中重新输入它们。

paragraphs.en: The frontend consumes real sidecar events over localhost HTTP/NDJSON and SSE. Secrets belong to the local authority: Secrets are held by the sidecar / OS keychain, never in the frontend .
paragraphs.zh: 前端通过本地主机的 HTTP/NDJSON 和 SSE 消费真实的边车事件。 密钥归本地权限机构所有：密钥由边车 / 操作系统密钥链持有，绝不存放在前端。

paragraphs.en: npm run test:fast # required merge gate npm run test:http # live sidecar HTTP/E2E suite npm test # validation + world + fast + HTTP suites npm run security:secrets # full-history secret scan; requires Gitleaks in PATH The release aggregate is npm run qa:ready . It is candidate-bound: any new commit invalidates the prior READY receipt until the affected live gates are rerun.
paragraphs.zh: npm run test:fast # 必需的合并门禁 npm run test:http # 真实 sidecar 的 HTTP/E2E 测试套件 npm test # 验证 + world + fast + HTTP 套件 npm run security:secrets # 全历史密钥扫描；要求 PATH 中安装 Gitleaks 发布聚合命令是 npm run qa:ready 。 它与候选版本绑定：任何新提交都会使先前的 READY 凭据失效，直到受影响的实时门禁重新运行为止。

sents.zh: 它与候选版本绑定：任何新提交都会使先前的 READY 凭据失效，直到受影响的实时门禁重新运行为止。

paragraphs.en: Contributions are welcome — read CONTRIBUTING.md and follow the Code of Conduct .
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎贡献——请阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md 并遵循行为准则（Code of Conduct）。

paragraphs.en: Do not report vulnerabilities in a public issue. Follow SECURITY.md for private reporting instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 请勿在公开的 issue 中报告漏洞。 请遵循 SECURITY.md 中的私密报告说明。
